faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: RinKuzu is an AI-powered personalized learning platform that transforms PDF documents into personalized quiz-based learning journeys using knowledge graphs and Bloom's Taxonomy.
faq.q2: How do I generate a quiz from a PDF?
faq.a2: Upload any PDF document (lecture notes, textbooks, or internal docs) and RinKuzu's AI automatically extracts key concepts, identifies prerequisites, and generates quizzes with explanations.
faq.a3: Yes. RinKuzu's free plan includes unlimited PDF-to-quiz generation, adaptive practice, mastery tracking, and community quiz browsing. A Premium plan offers advanced features and priority support.
faq.a4: RinKuzu supports Vietnamese and English with a full bilingual interface. Switch languages anytime using the language switcher in the navigation.
faq.q5: What is a knowledge graph in learning?
faq.a5: A knowledge graph maps relationships between concepts in your material. RinKuzu builds a visual graph showing prerequisite chains so you can see the learning path from fundamentals to advanced topics.
faq.q6: What is Bloom's Taxonomy and how does RinKuzu use it?
faq.a6: Bloom's Taxonomy classifies cognitive levels from Remember to Create. RinKuzu generates questions at each level, from basic recall to higher-order reasoning, ensuring deep mastery of every concept.
faq.q7: How does personalized learning work on RinKuzu?
faq.a7: RinKuzu tracks your performance using Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT), prioritizing questions on your weakest concepts. The AI adjusts difficulty dynamically for maximum efficiency.
faq.q8: Can I share my quizzes with others?
faq.a8: Yes! Set your quizzes to public to share with friends, classmates, or the RinKuzu community. Browse the Explore page for quizzes created by other users.
faq.q9: What types of questions does RinKuzu generate?
faq.a9: RinKuzu generates multiple-choice questions at all six Bloom's Taxonomy levels, each with a source-referenced explanation so you understand not just the answer but why it's correct.
faq.q10: Does RinKuzu work on mobile devices?
faq.a10: Yes. RinKuzu is a Progressive Web App (PWA) that works on desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers. Install it for an app-like experience with offline access.
faq.a11: Currently PDF documents are supported. Support for Word docs, PowerPoint slides, and plain text is on our roadmap.
faq.q12: How is my data and privacy protected?
faq.a12: Uploaded PDFs are processed securely and kept private by default. We never use your content to train AI models. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
faq.q13: What is the AI tutor Rin-chan?
faq.a13: Rin-chan is RinKuzu's built-in AI tutor. It explains any concept from your PDF in plain language, answers follow-up questions, and guides you through difficult topics, available 24/7.
faq.q14: How do I track my learning progress?
faq.a14: The Dashboard shows your mastery level per concept, accuracy trends, weak topics, and completion rates. Bookmark quizzes for later and review your history anytime.
faq.q15: Can teachers use RinKuzu for classroom assessment?
faq.a15: Absolutely. Teachers can upload lecture PDFs to generate student quizzes, track class-wide performance, and identify concepts that need re-teaching, ideal for formative assessment.
